During the 1972 Winter Olympics , it hosted the opening ceremonies and the speed skating events. [ 1 ] Located inside the Makomanai Park , the stadium holds 17,324 people. the Makomanai Park , the stadium holds 17,324 people. Currently the stadium holds the speed skating Winter Annual National Competition, and until 2011 the Toyota Big Air snowboarding contest. During summer it is used as tennis courts (up to eight at the same time) or futsal fields (up to two at the same time). As of 2021, the Olympic cauldron is still seemingly mounted on the original 1972 plinth, just within the stadium's south east perimeter.
